CONSTRUCTION AGREEMENT - RESIDENTIAL BUILDING
Plot 14, Oyarifa Hills Estate, Accra

Between: Kwame Asante (Client)
And: Boateng & Sons Building Works, represented by Yaw Boateng (Contractor)

1. SCOPE OF WORKS
Completion of a 4-bedroom single-storey residence from substructure (already completed by Client) to handover, including blockwork, lintels, ring beam, roofing, plastering, electrical and plumbing first and second fix, tiling, doors and windows, and external painting. Roofing: 0.55mm long-span aluminium roofing sheets on treated timber trusses, as per drawing A-07.

2. CONTRACT SUM
The total contract sum is GHS 412,000 (Four Hundred and Twelve Thousand Ghana Cedis), inclusive of labour and materials listed in the Bill of Quantities. Any change of materials requested by the Client (including roofing type) will be priced separately as a variation.

3. PAYMENT SCHEDULE
Tranche 1 - 25% on signing (mobilisation).
Tranche 2 - 25% on completion of blockwork to ring beam level.
Tranche 3 - 30% on completion of roofing.
Tranche 4 - 20% on practical completion and handover.
Payments to be made by bank transfer within 7 days of the Client's site verification.

4. DURATION
The works shall be completed within nine (9) months from the commencement date of 1 June 2026.

5. DELAY
If the Contractor fails to complete the works within the agreed duration, for reasons not attributable to the Client or to force majeure, the Contractor shall pay liquidated damages of GHS 1,500 per week of delay, up to a maximum of GHS 20,000.

6. DEFECTS
The Contractor shall make good any defects notified within six (6) months after handover at no cost to the Client.

7. SITE
The Contractor is responsible for site security and for keeping the site clean. Working hours Monday to Saturday, 7:00 to 17:30. No work on Sundays.

8. DISPUTES
Disputes shall first be referred to mediation by a member of the Ghana Institution of Engineering acceptable to both parties.

Signed: Kwame Asante ________   Yaw Boateng ________
Date: 24 May 2026
